tally.citation: Epic AC 2 claims `pyproject.toml:398` sdist `include` already excludes top-level `evals/`, but the bare `README.md` glob admits `evals/README.md` into the sdist, violating the packaging test that guards against future include changes.
tally.title: sdist include allowlist is not an allowlist: bare README.md glob ships files from any directory

tally.citation: Bug describes host-level uv binary mutation outside the repo; epic delivers corpus-root config, corpus move, and client harness docs—no changes to uv pinning, venv bootstrap, or binary provisioning.
tally.title: make venv fails for new worktrees: the uv binary inside the 0.12.7 pin directory was replaced with 0.13.6

tally.citation: Bug describes a flaky test in store commit maintenance detection (test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py), unrelated to eval harness exposure, corpus root configuration, or corpus relocation.
tally.title: Flaky: the bd66 maintenance DETECTOR test fails under full-suite load (the test added to fix a flake)

tally.citation: Bug describes a packaging defect in upstream pypandoc_binary 1.17 (x86_64 binary in arm64 wheel); epic delivers config seam, corpus move, and client documentation with no changes to pandoc dependencies or reconciler test infrastructure.
tally.title: make verify fails with 17 reconciler failures on arm64 macOS: pypandoc_binary 1.17's arm64 wheel ships an x86_64 pandoc
